name: 骨幹端異形成症(Schmid型)

summary.text: Schmid metaphyseal chondrodysplasia is a rare disorder characterized by moderately short stature with short limbs, coxa vara, bowlegs and an abnormal gait.

symptoms.text: moderately short stature with short limbs
